results.note: Wrong composer: the D-major trio (Moderato / Adagio / Rondo-Allegretto, as on the Christophorus disc) is by Charles-Auguste de Beriot (1802-70), the violinist, IMSLP 'Piano Trio No.2, Op.59', Schott 1847; IMSLP says Troupenas issued a 2nd trio as Op. 58 the same year. Charles-Wilfrid's IMSLP works stop at Opp. 50, 55, 56, 61. Op. 58/59 numbering is unsettled (a MusicWeb review calls Op. 58 'No. 1').
